# Sharealedger Community Call #2 — May 2020

**Date:** May 2020  
**Type:** Open community call (recorded)  
**Context:** Sharealedger organization founding period  
**Status:** Raw auto-generated captions. Not formal minutes.

---

## Context

The second open Sharealedger community call, held during the founding period of the organization (May 2020). The primary agenda was drafting and refining the Sharealedger vision statement. Participants reviewed Kip's draft and provided feedback on framing and emphasis.

Topics covered:
- Drafting the Sharealedger vision statement across three focus areas: data, interoperability, and accessibility
- Whether to frame the work relative to blockchain ("beyond blockchain's trustlessness") vs. a more affirmative framing ("building upon blockchain's goals")
- Multi-currency management and cryptocurrencies as an interoperability driver
- The accessibility dimension: bringing the smallest merchants and marginalized individuals into the digital economy via simple shared financial management on mobile devices
- Reference to the Jeff Wolfers dinner (~2007): "why don't we work on something that really matters"
